total.label: Total number of buildings
total.help: All buildings in the project area, including industrial buildings.

areaM2.label: Total project area
areaM2.help: Enter the area in m². The value in hectares is shown next to it.

shares.label: Share of buildings
shares.help: Enter the share of each building type and construction period in %. All shares must add up to 100 %.

potentials.label: Energy sources
potentials.help: Select the energy sources available or potentially available in the project area and rate their potential.

pv.label: Photovoltaic (PV) available
pv.help: PV lowers the electricity costs of the heat pumps by the PV cost reduction of Table 6.

manualDemand.label: Known heating and cooling demand
manualDemand.help: Optional. If you know the buildings' energy demand, enter it here instead of the default estimate.

heatingKwhPerYear.label: Total heating demand
heatingKwhPerYear.help: Optional. Replaces the estimated total heating demand.

coolingKwhPerYear.label: Total cooling demand
coolingKwhPerYear.help: Optional. Replaces the estimated total cooling demand.

networkLengthM.label: Network length
networkLengthM.help: Optional. Leave empty to estimate the length from the building density and the project area.

heating.label: Heating capacity per source (Table 4)
heating.help: Annual capacity per potential level in kWh/a, and the heat pump COP. Leave a cell empty to keep the default.

cooling.label: Cooling capacity per source (Table 5)
cooling.help: Annual capacity per potential level in kWh/a, and the COP. Leave a cell empty to keep the default.

economic.label: Economic parameters (Table 6)
economic.help: Leave a value empty to keep the default.

residential.label: Residential buildings
residential.description: Residential buildings of different construction periods.

category_a.label: Category A
category_a.description: Retail, museums, supermarkets, schools, offices and fitness studios.

category_b.label: Category B
category_b.description: Kindergartens, sports halls, hotels and theatres.

category_c.label: Category C
category_c.description: Hospitals, restaurants, swimming pools and canteens.

industry.label: Industry
industry.description: Industrial buildings and facilities. No default values exist, so any industry share leads to "Further analysis required".

installation_costs_ambient_air.label: Ambient air installation costs
installation_costs_ambient_air.help: Table 6 gives no value; the Quick Check uses 0.

densityCategory.label: Building density category
densityCategory.help: Calculated from the building density, not entered.
